RUMAL RUSH — SHURU KAISE KARNA HAI

1. ZIP download karke us par right-click → Extract All karo.
2. Roblox Studio kholo.
3. Upar File → Open from File par click karo.
4. Extracted folder mein RumalRush.rbxl select karo.
5. Upar blue Play button dabao.
6. Game ke andar PLAY A MATCH dabao.

Bas! Koi code paste ya plugin install nahi karna.

GAME KAISE KHELNA HAI
WASD se chalo.
Beech ka gold rumal E se uthao.
Apni team ki colored line tak wapas bhaago.
Agar doosra player rumal le jaye, uske paas jao — tag automatic hai.
Shift se chhota dash milega; phir cooldown hoga.
Pehle 3 points wali team jeetegi.

Akele ho toh Milo bot khelega.
Practice difficulty menu se EASY ya STANDARD kar sakte ho.
LOCKER mein earned coins se scarf colors aur trails milti hain.

NOTE
Local unpublished file mein coins sirf current session tak rehte hain.
Robux buying abhi OFF hai — tumhara real game-pass ID chahiye hoga.
File → Publish to Roblox tumhare apne account se karna hota hai.
Abhi public publish karne se pehle Play test karna zaroori hai.
Humne cloud par automated checks kiye hain; Roblox Studio ka actual test baqi hai.

FILES
RumalRush.rbxl         Main game — ye kholo.
RumalRush.rbxlx        Same game ka alternate XML format.
Arena-preview.png     Map geometry ka preview, Studio screenshot nahi.
source/               Poora editable code, build tools aur tests.
TEST-RESULTS.txt       Jo checks hue aur jo Studio mein baqi hain.
